title: Anfa expedition (1468)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Anfa expedition (1468)", at revision 1370428439, opens: "The Anfa Expedition of 1468 took place when a Portuguese fleet commanded by Duke Fernando of Viseu razed the town of Anfa, then one of the most important cities in Morocco and a pirate haven." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q116687226, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1468 military expedition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
